patterns.note: Asymmetrical two-column content blocks where text and imagery are offset, creating dynamic visual balance.
Prominent, heavy-weight sans-serif headings used for section titles, establishing a strong visual hierarchy.
A high-contrast palette of black and white, punctuated by a single vibrant green for key actions and branding.

A transforming sticky navigation bar that compacts and gains a solid background upon scroll, alongside a hero section featuring a foreground content card that scrolls at a different rate than its background image.
Alternating background colors (white and light grey) are used to clearly delineate major content sections, enhancing readability and visual flow.

technique_notes: The primary navigation bar dynamically shrinks and adopts a solid background color after the user scrolls past the initial hero section, maintaining visibility while saving vertical space. The hero section utilizes a parallax effect where the main image scrolls slower than the overlaying content block, creating a sense of depth and movement.

Content is frequently presented in a two-column grid, often with one column dedicated to a large image and the other to text, with the image and text columns alternating positions in subsequent sections to maintain visual interest.
Headings are rendered in a significantly larger and bolder sans-serif typeface than the body text, establishing clear content hierarchy and a modern, impactful tone.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body text) with generous line height, paired with a legible, regular-weight sans-serif for body copy.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding (approx. 8-12px) applied consistently to cards, buttons, and image containers.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced; ample vertical spacing between major sections, with a comfortable density for content within blocks.

standout: The site stands out with its bold, clean aesthetic, characterized by the striking contrast of a vibrant green accent against a monochrome black and white palette. The use of large, impactful photography paired with a distinct parallax scrolling effect in the hero section creates a dynamic and engaging first impression, moving beyond a static hero.
